description: Search all ~5.8 million corporations registered in Japan by name (Japanese, partial match). Returns corporate number, address, type and whether it is closed. Use the corporate number with get_company_profile.

name.description: Company name or part of it, in Japanese, e.g. トヨタ自動車

prefecture.description: Optional prefecture filter in Japanese, e.g. 大阪府

name: search_company
title: Search Japanese companies
